searchText: Just did another run on the DHT on mainnet. Looks like there are about 4k active nodes, and about 2.2k of those are unique ones with validators. is it possible to know how many of those 2.2k are in cloud?i With a bit more effort and greater uncertainty, we could probably identify via IP address as to which are on cloud providers 4k nodes for 400k validators?
